# HONU MPC layout aligned with HONU MRAC

The HONU MPC page now follows the same page geometry as the HONU MRAC page:

- the left control panel spans the full page height from the top edge;
- the compact two-row parameter panel is located only above the graph area;
- simulation, MPC run, stop, and full-screen actions are arranged vertically in the left panel;
- the activity indicator and status log remain below the action controls;
- numerical functionality and parameter names are unchanged.
